hypotheses.construction_plan: Define a one-parameter template F_theta0(n) = theta0 * K(n). Replace theta0 with a(n), b(n), and 1 to obtain the three target members respectively. The raw expression is the sum of the first two specializations; the third identifies the repeated factor K(n) as the unit-coefficient instance.
required_assumptions: K, a, b are arbitrary functions of n
hypotheses.rationale: F01 reports an LGG family with frozen template theta0*K(n) and witnesses a(n) and b(n); F02 reports K(n) as a common subexpression. The template theta0*K(n) directly generates the two product terms via specialization of theta0, and also generates the common factor K(n) as the specialization theta0=1.
